can.note: CAN id on the rack; joins every file here.

datasheet_peak_torque_nm.note: Peak output torque from the vendor datasheet; the card has it for the GIM4305 only.

floor.note: The measurement floor the budget compares the twin to: the RMS two identical runs disagree by. Measured for CAN 14 only; the other seven use a sine cycle-to-cycle proxy (drawn stand-in), because those stations have no repeated identical tape.

gates_not_run.note: Acceptance gates not run yet (pass + fail + partial + not run = 11).

gates_pass.note: Acceptance gates (T1-T11, rack_2026-10-24 acceptance.json) that passed.

part.note: Motor part from the model card (JMC parts are inferred from Kv/R, CAN 15 is unidentified).

ratio.note: Gear ratio from the datasheet (1 = direct drive).

repeat_floor.note: Floor from 5 identical floor-tape repeats on the pick-and-place tape (rack_2026-10-24 floors.json), every motor: a different tape and day than `floor`, so not comparable to `twin`.

terms_measured.note: Card rows with status measured (the others are board settings, datasheet, refused or pending).

twin.note: Full twin: median over all real runs of the RMS of (real - twin) joint angle, from the 10-23 budget. All the budget's runs are listed as held out. n = runs.

twin_over_floor.note: twin / floor: 1× would be indistinguishable from the rack repeating itself; see floor_kind for how trustworthy the floor is.
